title: Healthcheck Module Compiler
description: Compiles liveness and readiness health check handlers. Enforces: liveness never calls remote systems, readiness output is per-dependency and machine-readable, every dependency has a timeout, failing dependency produces deterministic result.

error_codes.HC002: Liveness check calls remote system (DB, HTTP, Redis) — liveness must be local-only
error_codes.HC003: Readiness output is not machine-readable per-dependency (must be JSON with status per dep)
error_codes.HC004: Dependency check has no timeout bound
error_codes.HC005: Health check performs destructive operation (write, delete, modify)
error_codes.HC006: Failing dependency does not produce deterministic unhealthy/degraded result
